data.summary:
Product-focused Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience in Capital Markets, specializing in market and reference data for derivatives and trade lifecycle
workflows. Proven track record in requirement gathering, SQL-based data analysis, and resolving data quality issues across risk and reporting systems. Strong collaborator across business, technology, and client-facing teams. Focused on improving data accuracy, enabling reliable downstream processes, and
translating business needs into scalable product solutions.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Product-focused Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience in Capital Markets, specializing in market and reference data for derivatives and trade lifecycle
workflows. Proven track record in requirement gathering, SQL-based data analysis, and resolving data quality issues across risk and reporting systems. Strong collaborator across business, technology, and client-facing teams. Focused on improving data accuracy, enabling reliable downstream processes, and
translating business needs into scalable product solutions.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Capital Markets: Derivatives (Futures & Options), Equities, Fixed Income, FX; Financial Instruments, Reference Data, Market Data, Pricing, Trade Lifecycle, Corporate Actions, Asset Servicing, Position Keeping, Reconciliation
Business & Product Analysis: Requirement Gathering, FRD/BRD, Product Specifications, Stakeholder Management, SIT/UAT, Release Coordination, SDLC (Agile & Waterfall), Business Case Development
Data & Analytics: Data Analysis, Reporting, Data Catalog & Lineage, Root Cause Analysis, Test Case Design for Financial Scenarios
Tools & Technologies: JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Advanced Excel, Python (Pandas), ITSM & ITIL, Postman, AI Tools (ChatGPT, Claude), Data Visualization Tools
Application Support: Vendor Coordination, Production Support (L1/L2/L3), Release Support
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Citi Senior Business Analyst – Capital Market
09/2023 – Present | Pune, India
Work with Risk, Operations, and Front Office to understand data requirements and support solutions across reference data and trade lifecycle systems.
Translate business needs into functional requirements and product specifications, contributing to scalable product decisions.
Analyze large datasets using SQL to validate financial data across asset classes including derivatives, equities, and fixed income.
Investigate data quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with vendors (Bloomberg, ICE, LSEG) for resolution.
Validate key market data attributes such as contract specifications, pricing, and expiries; support data governance and quality checks for downstream risk
and reporting systems.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate with engineering teams, and build test cases for complex financial data scenarios.
Document data lineage and maintain data catalog for critical market data attributes used across multiple downstream applications.
Identify opportunities for process automation using Python scripts to reduce manual data validation efforts by 30%.
Provide L2/L3 production support for market data feeds, investigating and resolving data discrepancies in timely manner.
Credit Suisse Business Analyst – Capital Market
12/2021 – 08/2023 | Pune, India
Collaborated with business and technology teams to gather and document requirements for reference data and trade lifecycle projects.
Performed data analysis and root cause investigation to resolve data quality issues impacting risk and reporting systems.
Ensured accuracy of market data and risk datasets across platforms, covering instruments like derivatives and FX.
Supported SIT and UAT cycles by validating business scenarios and coordinating for production release.
Northern Arc Capital Risk Analyst
04/2021 – 12/2021 | Chennai, India
Conducted financial and risk analysis of partner clients based on financial data; gathered inputs through stakeholder discussions.
Supported preparation of risk assessment reports for internal decision-making.
Harman Connected Business Analyst
04/2018 – 06/2019 | Pune, India
Worked with stakeholders and development teams to support requirement gathering, document functional requirements, and track issues.
Assisted in creating process flow diagrams and wireframes to visualize business workflows for development teams.
Conducted gap analysis between current system capabilities and business requirements, identifying areas for improvement.
Facilitated daily stand-up meetings and coordinated with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
Performed UAT testing and validated system functionality against business requirements before production deployment.
Tech Mahindra Data Analyst – ITSM
11/2014 – 04/2018 | Pune, India
Handled day-to-day data processes and issue resolution based on SLA; provided L1/L2 support for data and application issues.
Monitored data processes, resolved discrepancies, and supported incident, problem, and change management activities.
Assisted in QA and release validation by checking data outputs and maintaining operational documentation.
